Scarlet DeliriumRank 1
20% of base
2 sec cast
Requires Mortal Form
Flood the minds of up to 5 nearby enemies with visions of unraveling flesh, fearing them for 40 sec (8 sec versus players) while draining their life essence, siphoning 8+0+SP*0.15 health every 3 sec.

Damage caused may interrupt the effect.
